commands.description: Read the active Creator project identity and editor context.
Search project asset paths and bounded JavaScript/TypeScript source text.
Search Creator AssetDB records and return bounded asset identity metadata.
Find bounded text-file references to one exact AssetDB UUID under assets/. Reports incomplete scans and skips binary formats; an incomplete scan cannot prove that no references exist.
Plan importing one user-selected regular file into an existing assets folder through Creator AssetDB. Binds the external source SHA-256 and absent destination; does not write.
After native Creator approval, import the exact planned file bytes through AssetDB, then read back the target SHA-256, generated .meta UUID, importer, and asset type.
Read and reconcile one interrupted AssetDB import against its source hash, exact target, AssetDB UUID, and generated .meta. Never retries the import.
Plan moving or renaming one existing file asset through Creator AssetDB. Binds source UUID, file/.meta hashes, importer and type; destination must be absent and retain the source extension.
After native Creator approval, move or rename the exact asset via AssetDB and verify the original path is absent while UUID, bytes, .meta, importer, and type match at the destination.
Read and classify both paths for an interrupted AssetDB move by UUID and file/.meta hashes. Never repeats the move.
Plan creating one Prefab from an exact active-scene node through the Creator Scene panel. Binds the scene and node UUIDs and an absent .prefab target; does not write.

After native Creator approval, create the exact planned Prefab through the Creator Scene panel, then verify the generated AssetDB UUID, serialized asset, importer, and .meta identity. Never hand-edits Prefab serialization.
Read and reconcile one interrupted Creator-authored Prefab creation against its exact target URL, AssetDB UUID, serialized source, and .meta. Never reruns the Scene panel command.

Inspect one exact AssetDB Prefab's saved .prefab and .meta identity, bounded node hierarchy, transforms, active flags, and supported Sprite/Label properties. Reports disk state only; it does not inspect unsaved Prefab edit-mode state.

Inspect one live scene Prefab instance by scene/node UUID, including its exact linked Prefab asset, root identity, bounded descendant links, and saved scene/Prefab hashes. Does not apply, revert, or save overrides.

Plan an allowlisted edit to an existing Prefab in Creator Prefab edit mode. Apply binds the inspected source hash and explicit before/after values; compensation and replay derive their inverse from a completed source operation.

After native Creator approval, enter the exact Prefab edit mode, apply the allowlisted node changes, save, exit, reopen, verify the live node, and reread the exact Prefab and .meta. Writes are never automatically retried.
Observe the saved Prefab and current edit-mode state for one interrupted source patch. Classifies before, after, unsaved, or conflicting state and never repeats the mutation.
Freeze bounded inline JavaScript and JSON input for an explicit Creator Editor execution approval. Source runs with Editor privileges, is not sandboxed, and has no automatic persistence verification.

After native Creator approval, execute the exact planned inline script and return its bounded JSON result. Script effects and persistence are not verified; interrupted calls require manual review and are never replayed.
Read the recorded state and bounded result of one inline Editor script operation. Never executes or retries the script.

Freeze a project package editor-scripts JavaScript file and JSON input for an explicit Creator Editor execution approval. Only packages/*/editor-scripts/*.js paths without symlinks are accepted; source runs with Editor privileges and is not sandboxed.

After native Creator approval, execute the exact planned and hash-checked editor script file and return its bounded JSON result. Script effects and persistence are not verified; interrupted calls require manual review and are never replayed.
Read the recorded state and bounded result of one editor script file operation. Never executes or retries the file.
Read a project JavaScript or TypeScript source file and its Creator metadata identity.
Plan deleting one exact main file asset only when a complete bounded text-reference scan finds no incoming UUID references. Refuses sub-assets, assets with sub-assets, symlinks, and incomplete scans.
After native Creator approval, recheck asset identity, file/.meta hashes, sub-asset status, and a complete no-reference scan; delete through AssetDB and verify both files and row are absent.
Observe and classify one interrupted AssetDB deletion using the exact asset UUID, file, and .meta. Never repeats deletion.
Plan changing allowlisted Creator 2.4 texture importer settings for one exact PNG/JPEG AssetDB asset. Preserves other metadata and does not write.
After native Creator approval and a second precondition check, save allowlisted texture settings through AssetDB and verify the exact source and full .meta readback.
Observe the exact texture UUID, source hash, and complete .meta state after an interrupted settings save. Never calls saveMeta again.
Read a bounded hierarchy snapshot of the current Creator scene.
Read one exact node in the active scene by scene UUID and node UUID, including its full bounded path, active state, component classes, and current-session component instance IDs.

Plan a bounded Creator 2.4 scene composition of new nodes, optional AssetDB-backed Prefab instances, transforms, registered components, typed scalar or asset properties, and Button click handlers. Prefab roots are instantiated as authored and cannot receive additional components or Button edits in this operation. Existing scene nodes are read-only parents or event targets.

Apply one exact planned composition after Creator approval and fresh precondition checks, instantiate any listed Prefab assets through cc.instantiate, request scene save, and verify same-session readback plus exact AssetDB .fire/.meta semantics including PrefabInfo links. The receipt keeps sceneSaveCompletionConfirmed false because Creator documents no save IPC acknowledgement.
Reconcile an interrupted scene composition without replaying or saving it; verifies the original .fire/.meta semantic contents when available and otherwise reports the current in-memory observation.

Plan renaming one existing authoring-scene node, bound to scene/node UUIDs, parent UUID, current path/name, a collision-free sibling name, and the exact saved .fire/.meta baseline. Does not modify the scene.

After Creator approval, rename the exact planned node if its live and saved scene before-state still matches, request scene save, and confirm completion only after the exact serialized node state reads back from disk.
Read and reconcile one interrupted node rename against both editor memory and the exact saved .fire/.meta before/after state. Reports save-required if only memory changed; never repeats the rename.
Plan deleting one exact non-root node and its descendant subtree in the active Creator 2.4 scene. Binds the bounded descendant UUID/name/parent/order snapshot (up to 256 nodes); does not mutate.
After native Creator approval and fresh identity checks, detach and destroy the planned node subtree, request scene save, and verify the exact node is absent from the live hierarchy.
Observe one interrupted scene-node subtree deletion by original operation ID. Never repeats the deletion or claims disk-save completion without an acknowledgement.
Plan removal of one exact component instance by scene/node UUID, class name, and current-session instance ID. Rejects components required by another component.
After native Creator approval and fresh identity checks, destroy the exact planned component instance, request scene save, and verify its current-session instance ID is no longer valid.
Observe one interrupted exact component removal by original operation ID. Never repeats the removal.

Plan moving one existing authoring-scene node under one exact existing parent UUID. Binds live and saved node identity/path/parent state, rejects cycles and sibling-name collisions, and states that local transforms stay while world position may change.

After Creator approval, reparent the exact node if its live and saved before-state still matches; request a scene save and confirm completion only after the exact serialized hierarchy reads back from disk. Reparenting keeps local transforms and may change world position and lifecycle callbacks.

Read and reconcile one interrupted node reparent against editor memory and the exact saved .fire/.meta before/after hierarchy. Reports save-required if only memory changed; never repeats the mutation.

Plan a single active-state change for one existing node in the active scene, bound to scene/node UUIDs, the observed before-state, and the exact saved .fire/.meta baseline. Does not modify or save the scene.

Apply one planned active-state change after a native Creator confirmation, live and saved scene identity/before-state checks, then request scene save and confirm completion only after the exact serialized node state reads back from disk.

Read and reconcile one planned scene-node active-state operation against editor memory and the exact saved .fire/.meta before/after state. Reports save-required if only memory changed; never retries the mutation or claims a Creator save acknowledgement.

Plan changes to selected transform fields on one existing scene node. The live state must match the exact AssetDB-saved .fire/.meta baseline; values are bound to both before-states and no scene change is made.

Apply one planned transform update after native Creator approval and exact live/disk before-state checks, request scene save, and confirm persistence only after the exact serialized AssetDB .fire/.meta node transform reads back from disk.

Read and reconcile one interrupted transform operation against exact live and saved scene before/after state; reports save-required when memory changed but disk did not, and never repeats the mutation.

Plan replacing the bounded click-event list on one exact existing cc.Button instance. Binds the unique serialized Button and exact saved event list from the AssetDB .fire/.meta. Every new target and handler is resolved against the active scene and registered component methods.

Replace the exact planned Button click-event list after native Creator approval and a second live and saved before-state check, then request scene save. Completion requires semantic readback of the planned serialized events from the exact AssetDB .fire; reports save-required if only editor memory changed.

Observe and reconcile one interrupted Button click-event update by exact scene, node, component instance, and live and serialized before/after lists. Reports save-required when memory changed but disk did not; never retries the mutation.
Plan adding one registered Cocos component class to one exact scene node. Rejects missing classes, existing instances, and components with implicit required components; no scene change is made.

Add the exact planned component class after Creator approval and fresh scene/node/component precondition checks, then request scene save and read the component count back in the same Creator scene session.
Observe and reconcile one planned component-add operation after interruption. Never retries the mutation; an observed component without a persisted instance identity requires manual review.

Plan changing one declared public serializable scalar, supported typed value, bounded typed array, active-scene node reference, component-instance reference, or supported AssetDB resource property on one exact component instance. Binds the saved AssetDB .fire/.meta, component ID, serialized class ID, owning node, and property value. Arbitrary project objects, lifecycle, and internal fields are rejected.

Apply the exact planned component-property change after native Creator approval and fresh live and saved before-state checks. Request scene save, then confirm the serialized component identity and property in the exact AssetDB .fire; reports save-required if memory changed but persistence was not verified.

Observe one component-property operation against both live state and the exact saved .fire/.meta. Reports save-required when only memory changed and confirms completion after a matching manual save. Never reapplies the value; a changed Creator session or missing original component instance requires manual review.

Prepare a Creator AssetDB script-creation plan in an existing assets folder, with an absent-target precondition, source hash, operation ID, and recovery conditions. Does not modify project assets or create folders.

Create the exact script asset described by a pending plan after an explicit Creator confirmation dialog and a fresh absent-target precondition check; returns AssetDB identity, readback hashes, and recovery conditions.
Reconcile a planned or uncertain script-creation operation by reading the same Creator AssetDB target and matching source/.meta identities; never retries or writes the asset.

Plan replacing the source of one existing JS/TS asset after matching its expected source SHA-256, AssetDB UUID/importer, and .meta hash. Stores the prior source outside the project and does not write.

Replace the exact planned script source through Creator AssetDB after native approval and fresh source/UUID/importer/.meta precondition checks. Returns Creator readback and compile-event evidence without claiming compilation succeeded unless observed.

Read and reconcile one planned or uncertain script-source modification by source hash, AssetDB identity, importer, and unchanged .meta hash. Never replays the write; compile diagnostics remain separate evidence.
Plan an exact Creator AssetDB reimport for one unchanged script asset, bound to its source hash, UUID, importer, and .meta hash.

After native Creator approval, refresh one exact script through AssetDB and return the importer result plus correlated script-import-failed diagnostics. Does not edit source or claim success when AssetDB returns no matching import result.
Read and reconcile the persisted result of one exact script AssetDB refresh. Never reruns the import.
Read bounded Creator compile events, script import failures, and editor Console messages since a sequence cursor.
After a native Creator approval, request the active scene Web preview and attach a dedicated local browser session bound to this Creator instance and scene.
Read runtime Console entries, active page, canvas, and scene from the exact attached preview session.
Capture a PNG from the same attached preview session and return its local path, SHA-256, and scene identity.
Apply bounded keyboard or normalized canvas clicks in the same preview session and evaluate declarative runtime assertions.
Reload the attached preview browser page and re-check the expected scene inside the same preview session.
Close the Agent-owned preview browser session; the Creator preview server remains under Creator control.
Discover live, project-local Creator extensions that implement the Cocos Agent command provider contract.
Invoke a live project extension command declared read-only in its Creator command provider contract.
Invoke a live project extension command declared as a non-mutating plan in its Creator command provider contract.
Invoke a project extension command declared as a write only after an explicit native Creator approval dialog.
Invoke a project extension command declared as a control action only after an explicit native Creator approval dialog.
